CFML Language Reference: Functions

ListDeleteAt

Returns a copy of a list with the element at the given position removed, together with one of the delimiters next to it.

Category

List functions

Syntax

ListDeleteAt(list, position [, delimiters ])

Parameters

list
The list to change.
position
The index of the element to remove, from 1 to ListLen(list).
delimiters
Optional. The delimiter characters of the list; the default is a comma.

Returns

The new list.

Usage

A position less than 1 or greater than the number of elements causes an error. To remove an element by value, find it first with ListFind, as the example does.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Planets = "Mercury,Venus,Earth,Mars,Jupiter,Saturn,Uranus,Neptune,Pluto">
<CFSET Pos = ListFind(Planets, "Earth")>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Before: #Planets#</P>
<P>Without element 1: #ListDeleteAt(Planets, 1)#</P>
<P>Without "Earth" (element #Pos#): #ListDeleteAt(Planets, Pos)#</P>
<P>Without the last one: #ListDeleteAt(Planets, ListLen(Planets))#</P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ListFind, ListInsertAt, ListSetAt, ArrayDeleteAt
